description: This Java class 'InlineCOBLoanItemListener' extends 'AbstractLoanItemListener' and is part of the COB (Close Of Business) processing mechanism for loans in the Fineract project. It provides a specific lock owner for inline COB processing of loans.

classes.name: InlineCOBLoanItemListener
classes.description: A listener class that handles COB loan items with inline processing, providing a specific lock owner.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with loan locking service and transaction template.

methods.description: Returns the LockOwner enum value for inline COB loan processing.
